_comment: Both `app` pages load `lib-app` and `lib-both`, and both `public` pages load `lib-public` and `lib-both`. Merging `lib-app` or `lib-public` into `lib-both` would save two pages a request each, but only `app` loads `lib-app` and only `public` loads `lib-public`, so even an unlimited budget never merges them: `public` would download `lib-app`, which nothing reachable from it imports.
